project.name: Vibes Presentation
project.description: A 20-slide presentation about vibe coding and AI-assisted development

prompts.prompt: This project existings solely to be a presentation with 20 slides. Let's first setup a few basic manifest files to describe what this is to keep as a constant reference. We should also keep the content separate from the presentation. Create an index.html file that we'll work on to see this in a browser.

Established manifest files for project documentation
Set up index.html as main presentation interface
